text:
Matt: Canary for adaptive-prefetch-policy v2 finished. Short-chat p99 down ~18% (420ms -> 344ms), mean token cost -9%. No user-facing errors in canary (10k requests). Rolling to staged rollout unless anyone objects.
Anya: amazing! do we have dashboard and PR?
Matt: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/abc123/prefetch-v2 ; PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821
Sree: memory impact? evictions?
Matt: mem +2% on avg per pod, but cache hit ratio improved ~14 percentage points so overall tail work is lower. no OOMs in canary.
Jordan: any change to config flags? will rolling change defaults?
Matt: new flag `prefetch.policy=delayed_adaptive` (default FORCED=false). rollout plan: 10% pods with feature=true -> 50% -> 100%. fallback toggle exists: `prefetch.policy=off`.
ops-bot: canary monitor snapshot: p50/p95/p99 and token_econ look healthy. creating staged rollout job.
Matt: Quick rollout playbook: 10% now -> watch p50/p95/p99 & token_econ dashboards for 30-60m -> promote to 50% if stable for 1h -> 100% after 3-4h if no regressions. Abort conditions: p99 regresses >5% or error rate >0.1% above baseline. I'll add to runbook.
Anya: please update changelog and release notes — customers might see cost drop and ask.
Matt: will do. Also adding a note for SRE: we can relax the "cache eviction" alert threshold since evictions should drop with this policy.
Sree: please add unit tests for the new prefetch heuristic and a CI config sanity check.
Matt: PR includes tests and perf bench script. tagging eng-runtime, eng-sre for visibility @here :rocket:
deploy-bot: staged rollout started: 10% of runtime-pool tagged prefetch-v2 (job id r-20260323-71)
Jordan: nice work team. let's track overnight AM hours for the next day.
